briefdescription.para: IPDBRawSymbol defines an interface used to represent an arbitrary symbol.

detaileddescription.para: It exposes a monolithic interface consisting of accessors for the union of all properties that are valid for any symbol type. This interface is then wrapped by a concrete class which exposes only those set of methods valid for this particular symbol type. See PDBSymbol.h for more details.
